findings.rationale: Aéronef preserves the broader aircraft category. Huit projets pilotes avoids confusing integration pilots with people. Exécution des services prévus is accompanied by dispatch and its source definition; no single public-service score is introduced.

Aeronave, ocho proyectos piloto and seguridad operacional preserve category and safety scope. Registros de despacho retains the stated explanation. Certification, operator approval and availability remain different claims.
